summary: Wrote the implementation plan for the paper's nomic frames: a new FormalSystem/Semantics/Nomic/ cluster of four modules (Frame, Recovery, ZTime, Witnesses) plus a sibling aggregator and README, sited under Semantics/ rather than OpenLanguage/ with the dependency-direction trade-off recorded. Seven phases over 11 hours in five dependency waves: frame layer, lem:nomic-recovery, the ZTime presentation and step-path invariants, witnesses 1 and 3, witness 2 plus the bundled hierarchy theorem, a conditional thm:nomic-primitive clause (1), and a final full-gate wiring phase. Phases 1-3 are transcription of research text already compiled sorry-free; the real proof work is stepPath_forward_invariant, witness 2 and witness 3. The plan pins 27 identifiers under Lean Challenge Statements and records the territory protocol for FormalSystem.lean and FormalSystem/Semantics.lean, both inside concurrent task 789's declared file_scope.

artifacts.summary: Seven-phase, 11-hour plan for the nomic frame cluster, its two lemmas and prop:nomic-hierarchy's three witnesses.
